title: Wavelength history entry (one line of history/log.jsonl)
description: One revision of a Wavelength song, format version 1.0 (docs/song-format.md, Draft 1, section 6). Rules across lines (rev increasing, parent/target naming earlier revisions, objects that exist and hash to their names) are checked by `wavelength validate` and scripts/wavelength_song.py. CC0.

rev.description: One more than the line before (pruning may leave gaps).

time.description: RFC 3339. Also the git author and committer date.

parent.description: The revision the song was at before this one (0 for the first).

named.description: save entries: true when someone named the save point (it then has a message).

files.description: The full snapshot: every tracked path (the job and files whose role is source, notes or media) and the hash of its content, stored in history/objects/.

render.description: render entries: hashes of the report and mix that were made, and their loudness summary.

target.description: undo, redo, restore: the revision whose files were restored.

path.description: Same rule as the manifest's paths (section 2).
